title: Crystal River Sport Fishing

services.name: Scalloping
services.desc: Florida’s Nature Coast is an inshore fishing paradise. Four Hour Charter About A private scallop charter in Crystal River, Florida is the perfect activity for a group of friends looking to relax, connect and enjoy some quality time in the beauty of the Nature Coast. With its picturesque shoreline, clear emerald-green waters, and a laid-back tropical atmosphere, this special river makes for an unforgettable experience. While everyone else heads to a crowded pool, you can find yourself in a different kind of water setting, complete with emerald green waters and gorgeous scenery. We’re 4 Hours • Morning & Afternoon Trips • Scallop Equipment Included • Up to 6 People • Starting at $500

quotes.text: Captain JAYCE is the bomb. From the early communications all the way to the end of our trip he was all you could ask for in a captain. This young man has so much going for him. We were a group of seniors, some not so proficient and some newbies. He helped us from start to finish and even helped us arrange to have our fresh catch fried at the food truck located at the marina. It was delicious. Quite a memory. Thank you Captain JAYCE.

This trip was for my husbands birthday. It did not disappoint!!! Our Captain Jayce Massaro was superb. He was extremely professional, attentive and a great teacher. We caught grouper and trout and we’re very happy. It was a nice boat and great trip overall. I highly recommend him and High Octane!!! Thank you again Captain Jayce!! Wishing you a Merry Christmas and the very best future success!!!

The absolute best Charter I’ve ever been on. Captain Jayce Massaro worked his butt off keeping us on the fish all day. Ever seen a strawberry grouper? We caught and released one. We caught Doral, Snook and two impressive nurse sharks. After we found our way to Rocks Corner, we limited out on Gag Grouper. I couldn’t have had a more enjoyable day. Thanks for the memories Cap’n Jayce, well done!

If I had to rate Captain Jayce Massaro from 1 to 10, I’d make him an 11!!!!! He has an excellent knowledge of the waters and always put us on fish. I’ve fished with him several times and always get fish. Lots of fun. I’d recommend him to anyone!

Captain jayce is the man you want to call to get out on a trip. Very knowledgeable and professional. He took me out on a days notice with my grandma and girlfriend. We caught a limit of sheeps and had a great time.
Jayce is awesome. He gets you on the fish! Also very good with young anglers. Took my son who has limited fishing experience so far. Jayce is very patient and helpful to a newbie. Highly recommend.
